title: Evaluation-Free Recursive Self-Improvement for Coding Agents
code_status: No verifiable paper-specific author source repository found in fixed v1; mini-swe-agent is a cited dependency

cost_assessment.basis: Full 10 generations×7 children×three runs with 1,800-second container timeouts and multi-benchmark APIs are high cost; callback protocol itself cheap
cost_assessment.decision: 完整实验成本过高，不复现（审查DONE）；只运行已声明CPU局部机制。

summary: ELITE质疑反复在固定下游任务上evaluate-and-select的成本与适应偏差。冻结模型，演化可执行scaffold代码：同一parent先给出多个聚焦改进假设，每条假设独立实现，经过确定性有效性检查后交给LLM integrator。它不是从得分最高子代里挑一个。
fidelity_note: 本地L0 generation真实调用独立explore、exploration_gate、integrate、acceptance_gate；共同parent映射不可变，越界／空patch和非bool门结果拒绝。IntegrationRequest只有parent与有效children，不接收任务成绩／轨迹。失败acceptance或无有效子代保留原parent，不选择“次优分数”。回调可编译示例源码但没有LLM、SWE容器或安全沙箱。
